model_pins.description: Exact Claude model IDs pinned per tier for plugin/. HC0-F2: healthcare customers require reproducible behavior — 'opus' or 'sonnet' aliases can drift as Anthropic releases new versions. This file is the source of truth; ./synaptory build copies it into the distribution and the AI-BOM generator reads it.
model_pins.runtime_variants_note: Claude Code surfaces 1M-context variants via suffixes like '-1m' or '[1m]' in the SDK Usage.model field (e.g. 'claude-opus-4-7-1m'). Per Anthropic's Long-context-pricing policy these variants bill at IDENTICAL per-token rates as the base model — they are NOT separate SKUs. The control-plane pricing logic strips known suffixes before lookup; see api/synaptory_api/routers/analytics.py::_normalise_model_id and ::_PRICED_VARIANT_SUFFIXES. Adding new variants here is informational only; cost computation is automatic once the suffix is in _PRICED_VARIANT_SUFFIXES.

opus.notes: Used by strategic roles: project-owner, solution-architect, compliance-engineer, research-advisor. The 1M variants run when Claude Code is configured for >200K context; they bill identically to the base model.

sonnet.notes: Used by executor roles: software-engineer, quality-engineer, platform-engineer, technical-writer, code-reviewer. Anthropic is running a $2/$10 per-MTok intro rate through 2026-08-31; the control-plane cost table pins the $3/$15 list rate.

haiku.notes: Not currently used by synaptory roles; reserved for future low-latency auxiliaries. Anthropic does NOT publish a 1M variant for Haiku 4.5 — treat 'claude-haiku-4-5-1m' model IDs as unsupported.
